S01 E01 — Blood Is Thicker Than Water

title: Most Terrifying With Jason Hawes
description:
S01 E03 — Prison of the Dead
Jason Hawes knows there's no rest for the wicked. Long-dead prisoners prowl an old English jail, a decommissioned warship is haunted by the agonized victims of a grisly tragedy, and sinister spirits roam the upper floor of a historic building.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E08 — Kreischer Mansion
Katrina takes Jack to Kreischer Mansion in Staten Island, N.Y., where a past paranormal experience left her searching for answers; a new spirit has taken up residence since Katrina's last visit, but it may not be who the new owners think it is.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E03 — Taylor Trask Museum
Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman head to Plymouth, Mass., to investigate the historic Taylor Trask Museum; the caretaker, Jan, wants to calm the restless spirits, but with the recent uptick in paranormal activity, she fears for her safety.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E01 — Hill View Manor
Jack and Katrina travel to Hill View Manor in New Castle, Pa., a shuttered nursing home where former patients are rumored to live on in death, and they cross paths with the Creeper, an evil shadow creature bent on tormenting its victims.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E05 — Fort Mifflin
Katrina Weidman takes Jack Osbourne to one of her favorite hotspots; Philadelphia's Fort Mifflin is a location rife with the ghosts of wars long past.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E02 — Eloise Psychiatric Hospital
Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman investigate Eloise Psychiatric Hospital in Detroit, Mich.; once known for its cutting-edge facilities, Eloise is notorious for its aggressive spirits and is host to a dark entity that delights in choking its victims.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E12 — Pamplin Historical Park

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E04 — Savannah Theatre
Katrina Weidman and Jack Osbourne investigate the Savannah Theatre in Savannah, Ga., a paranormal playhouse dating back almost 200 years; the duo takes the stage and discovers that this theater likes to put on a horror show.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E07 — Malco Theatre
Jack and Katrina investigate a live magic venue in the bubbling resort town of Hot Springs, Ark.; in a location charged by strange geothermal forces, not all phenomena in this former movie palace appears to be the trick of a magician.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E06 — Missouri State Penitentiary
The team heads to the infamous Missouri State Penitentiary in Jefferson City, Mo.; with a history of suffering and violence that goes back over a century, Jack Osbourne and Katrina Weidman look to finally unlock what may be haunting this location.

title: Portals to Hell
description:
S03 E09 — Ernestine and Hazel's
Jack and Katrina investigate a Memphis, Tenn., blues bar with a sordid past; the team seeks to help a former bartender confront both the light and dark forces haunting the mysterious music hall.

title: Portals to Hell
description:

Jack and Katrina travel to San Antonio to investigate the site of a key battle in the Texas revolution, but when a malevolent energy targets Katrina, the team quickly learns this will be no ordinary investigation.

title: Portals to Hell
description:

The mysterious town of Marfa, Texas, is Jack and Katrina's next stop as the team investigates the Hotel Paisano, a well-known paranormal hot spot, but without known incidences of death on the property, they have their work cut out for them.

title: Portals to Hell
description:

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E01 — Breeding Ground
Bryce Johnson, Dr. Mireya Mayor and Russell Acord scour North America in search of the cryptid known as Bigfoot; they return to northern California to explore compelling evidence and unlock this centuries-old mystery.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E02 — Nests of Giants
Deep in the Northern California wilderness, Russell stops at nothing to reach a nesting site; Mireya and Bryce uncover evidence that a family of Bigfoot is nearby; Ben speaks with a witness who had a chilling encounter with Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E03 — The Watchers
Deep in Northern California's lost coast, an audio expert joins the fold after the team hears unusual sounds; Russell must take shelter from a storm; Bryce speaks with a local Hoopa Tribal Council member after reviewing illuminating footage.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E04 — Primal Fear
Russell searches a rugged hillside full of caves in Northern California's forests; Bryce speaks with a witness who hears frightening grunts; Mireya and Tobe Johnson expand their search area to determine if Bigfoot is mimicking animal sounds.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E05 — Watch Your Step
Russell discovers new sights and sounds deep in the backcountry of Northern California; Bryce talks with a witness who had an experience with a family of Bigfoot; Mireya reaches new heights in search of physical evidence of the elusive creature.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E06 — Smells Like Bigfoot
In NorCal's backcountry, the team develops a clear plan of attack to lure Bigfoot out of hiding; Russell travels overnight, hoping to gather key evidence in their search; Mireya and Bryce conduct an investigation unlike any other.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E07 — The Gathering Storm
The team's investigations converge as Bryce, Mireya and Russell discover tree structures on different sides of the same mountain; as a storm approaches, Bryce prepares an AI-powered surveillance array that will help pinpoint Bigfoot's location.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E08 — Bigfoot's Doorstep
Bryce, Mireya and Russell converge at the center of their NorCal hot zone as a catastrophic storm threatens the expedition; armed with AI technology, they're ready to meet the elusive cryptid before it's too late; Russell spies signs of Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E01 — Why Are They Here?
Months after the Northern California expedition, Bryce, Mireya, and Russell head to Washington after a fresh lead points to a target zone where Bigfoot groups are congregating for an unknown reason; Survivalist Biko Wright joins the hunt.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E02 — Warning Signals
South of a Bigfoot chokepoint in Washington, Russell follows a trail of warning signs into the backcountry; Mireya and Biko track what could be a curious Bigfoot; Bryce speaks with a witness, who wishes he never laid eyes on the cryptid creature.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E03 — Right on Track
In the heart of The Fork, Russell is on the trail of a possible pair of Bigfoot; Mireya and Biko utilize cutting-edge tech to try and catch a base camp intruder as Bryce makes a startling find while reviewing footage.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E04 — Perilous Descent
Deep in "The Fork," Russell rappels a 700-foot cliff to follow a heat signature; Mireya and Biko track signs outside their base camp; Bryce hears new information about strange vocalizations and discovers that someone has visited his command center.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E05 — Element of Surprise
Mireya and Biko navigate rapids while tracking a possible hunting party; Bryce gains knowledge from fresh prints; Russell creates a trap for Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E06 — Line of Sight
In Washington's backcountry, Mireya and Biko take cues from the land after finding a series of tree structures that lead them to a water source; Bryce gains insight into the mysterious print found at his cabin; Russell's bushcraft tripwire pays off.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E07 — A Predator Calls
In the heart of "The Fork," Biko howls into the night during a stakeout with Mireya; Bryce makes a surprising discovery at the cabin Russell has been occupying.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E08 — Target Identified
Bryce, Mireya, Russell and Biko converge at the high-activity area in "The Fork," which is equipped with state-of-the-art tech; as the interceptor drone and seismic tripwire activate, the team is led to a discovery they've never seen before.
